title: Our Favorite Subjects
text:
My favorite school subject is history. We learn about old kings and big cities. Our teacher tells stories and we draw maps.

Tom likes music. He plays the piano every day. His sister likes sports because she runs fast.

questions.text: What is the writer's favorite school subject?
What does Tom play every day?
Why do the history lessons seem interesting to the writer?
options: The teacher tells stories and the class draws maps
There are no books in the room
History is a kind of sport

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom's sister?
options: She is active and likes running

vocabulary.definition: accounts of events, either true or made up
drawings that show places and their positions
a large musical instrument with black and white keys

paragraph_translations: Мій улюблений шкільний предмет — історія. Ми вивчаємо старих королів і великі міста. Наш вчитель розповідає історії, а ми малюємо карти.
Том любить музику. Він грає на піаніно щодня. Його сестра любить спорт, тому що вона швидко бігає.
